reply.shortGloss: foot; base; foot of a page
reply.emotion: steady and grounded, feeling the solid floor beneath you
notes: Used in many common idioms like 'de pie' (standing) and 'a pie' (on foot).

senses.definition: Parte inferior de la pierna humana sobre la cual se asienta el cuerpo.

examples.text: Me duele el pie derecho después de correr tanto.
examples.translation: My right foot hurts after running so much.
examples.emotion: wincing slightly and rubbing a tired sore foot

senses.definition: Parte inferior o base de un objeto, mueble o estructura que lo sostiene.

examples.text: La lámpara tiene el pie muy pesado.
examples.translation: The lamp has a very heavy base.
examples.emotion: testing the weight of a shaky household object
